title: Cloning the green fluorescent protein gene
summary: Douglas Prasher cloned the gene for green fluorescent protein, the jellyfish glow protein, and shared it with Martin Chalfie and Roger Tsien.
why: GFP became a glowing tag used to watch genes and proteins in living cells.

unsung.contribution: Cloned the jellyfish GFP gene and gave it to the labs that turned it into a research tool.
unsung.recognition: Out of science by 2008, he was driving a courtesy shuttle bus when the 2008 Nobel went to Shimomura, Chalfie and Tsien.
